usageNotes: Permanently deletes a scheduled realm-sync job by its config ID, stopping any future automatic user/group synchronization from the associated authentication realm. The operation returns null synchronously — no UPID is issued, so deletion is immediate upon a successful response. Requires Sys.Modify at the root path; this privilege is typically held only by administrators.

examples.summary: Delete a realm-sync job for an LDAP realm

destructiveReason: Permanently removes the realm-sync job definition; scheduled synchronization of users and groups from the associated realm will no longer run.
tips: List existing realm-sync jobs first via GET /cluster/jobs/realm-sync to confirm the correct job ID before deleting.
Deleting the job does not remove users already synchronized into Proxmox — it only stops future sync runs.
The id must match the pve-configid format (alphanumeric, hyphens allowed, no spaces); an invalid id returns a 500 error, not a 404.
